shots.vo: What happens if you scream *"bombaclaat"* louder and louder?
A whisper. "Bombaclaat." The cat *didn't even wake up*.
Normal conversation. The neighbours *turn their heads*.
A jackhammer. Pigeons *fly off the roof*, people drop their phones.
The Guinness world record — an Australian town crier shouted this loud in 2026. You *just beat it*. With the word "bombaclaat".
A jet engine at take-off. It *hurts* now, windows are shaking.
That was measured 160 kilometres from Krakatoa in 1883. It was heard *4,800 kilometres* away. Your "bombaclaat" reaches the next continent.
194 decibels — *the limit*. Sound in air can't get any louder. Beyond that it's a shock wave that *circles the Earth*.
What word would you scream like that? Tell us in the comments.
